exposure: aerosol therapy with pure oxygen delivery
cohort: 205 preterm infants with a gestational age of 24-29 weeks receiving invasive intubation for more than 1 week in a tertiary level neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) from 2011 to 2013
finding: Aerosol therapy with pure oxygen delivery is an independent risk factor for ROP in mechanically ventilated preterm infants.
mod_finding: This study found no association between mode of delivery and retinopathy of prematurity in preterm infants.
